attributes.name: Prowess
attributes.description: Physical, outward attribute. Governs melee/ranged/finesse attack rolls and damage.

attributes.name: Vitality
attributes.description: Physical, inward attribute. Governs HP, AC soak/armour, and Vitality saves.

attributes.name: Intellect
attributes.description: Mental, outward attribute. Reserved for future caster (Curiosity) mechanics — out of scope until that calling is implemented.

attributes.name: Insight
attributes.description: Mental, inward attribute. Governs AC evasion, initiative, passive perception, and Insight saves.

attributes.name: Presence
attributes.description: Social, outward attribute. Governs Influence and converges with Prowess on Menacing Attack's DC.

attributes.name: Composure
attributes.description: Social, inward attribute. Governs Composure saves (fear/charm/compulsion, consolidated) and converges with Vitality on concentration.
